title: Beam coupon
description: The beam coupon, for cad measured: two printed 1515 beams 240 mm long, one printed lying down (k1) and one standing up (k2), each resting on two round bars 220 mm apart with 2 kg hung from its middle. Each one's sag is predicted (beam.coupon): read it with the joint rig's dial and write it back with cad measured benchmarks/beam-test k1.sag=<mm> (MEASURE.md, row 38), and the modulus a printed beam bends at goes to the plastic's set as measured. Then pull each down at its middle with the luggage scale until it breaks: k1.break=<kg> (row 39), and the stress it breaks at goes there too. Printed in PLA; for PETG, change both beams' material to petg and print again.
